Isle of Wandering

An endless world of smooth mountains, pine and broadleaf forests, sandy beaches and an open sea scattered with islands. Wander wherever you like — there are no edges. Watch for deer, rabbits and cats in the meadows and birds wheeling overhead, then walk up to a moored sailboat and press E to climb aboard and sail to the next island.
